title: [Control Systems] Siemens security advisory (AV26-1083)
description: As of October 26, 2026, Siemens is affected by a vulnerability in the following products:
products:
Mendix SAML (Mendix 10 compatible)
	Prior to V4.2.4

Mendix SAML (Mendix 11 compatible)
	Prior to V4.2.4

Mendix SAML (Mendix 9 compatible)
	Prior to V3.6.29
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
